pdpFaq.title: Frequently asked questions

items.question: How does the fit run?
items.answer: True to size, pick your usual size. Between two sizes? Go up for a slightly more relaxed silhouette. The size chart is right next to the size selector.

items.question: When will I receive my order?
items.answer: Order before 5 PM and we ship the same day with DHL. Usually at your door the next business day in NL and BE, otherwise the day after. Shipping is free from €{freeShipping}; below that it is €{shippingCost}.

items.question: What if the size doesn't fit?
items.answer: No worries. Return or exchange within 30 days. Sign in to your account, register the return and we'll email you a return label.

items.question: What makes this a MOSE piece?
items.answer: A considered fit and understated details. See the product description for the fabric, finishing and details of this model.

items.question: Can I pay in installments?
items.answer: Yes. With Klarna you can split your purchase into 3 payments at zero interest, or pay later within 14 days. Both options appear at checkout.

pdpFaq.answerVerzendingAltijd: Order today before 17:00 and it usually arrives tomorrow in NL and BE via DHL, otherwise the day after. Shipping is always free, with no minimum.

items.question: How do MOSE garments fit?
items.answer: Fits vary by style, from regular to boxy and relaxed. Use the product size chart and compare the measurements with a garment that fits you well. Get in touch if you need help.

items.question: What are the shipping costs and delivery time?
items.answer: Shipping costs and available delivery options appear at checkout. Processing and delivery times can vary by item. An order may arrive in separate parcels. You can follow your shipment once tracking is available.

items.question: Can I return my order?
items.answer: Yes! You have {returnDays} days to return from receipt. Items must be unworn with tags still attached. You can easily request a return via your customer portal. Return costs are €{returnCost} and will be deducted from your refund. You'll receive your refund within 5 business days.

items.question: How do I care for my MOSE clothing?
items.answer: Always follow the garment care label. Wash printed clothing inside out and do not iron directly on a print. See the product information for care details for that style. Ask us if you are unsure.

items.question: What does MOSE stand for?
items.answer: MOSE makes clothes for men with considered fits, fabrics and understated details. From T-shirts and hoodies to sweaters and trousers. Each product page explains what to expect from that style.

items.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: Available payment methods appear at checkout and depend on factors such as your country and currency. Choose the option you prefer; payments are processed securely.

faq.answerVerzendingAltijd: Available delivery options appear at checkout. Processing and delivery times can vary by item, and an order may arrive in separate parcels.

intro.title: 1. INTRODUCTION
intro.content: MOSE (mosewear.com) respects the privacy of all visitors to the website and ensures that the personal information you provide is treated confidentially. This privacy policy explains what data we collect and what we use it for.

dataCollection.title: 2. WHAT DATA DO WE COLLECT?
dataCollection.intro: We collect the following personal data:
items: Name and address (for shipping orders)
Email address (for order confirmations and communication)
Phone number (for delivery and customer service)
Payment details (securely processed via Mollie, not stored by us)
Order history and preferences

dataUsage.title: 3. WHAT DO WE USE YOUR DATA FOR?
items: Processing and shipping your orders
Communication about your order (confirmation, shipping, tracking)
Customer service and support
Improving our website and services
Marketing (only with your consent)

dataRetention.title: 4. HOW LONG DO WE KEEP YOUR DATA?
dataRetention.content: We do not retain your personal data longer than necessary for the purposes for which it was collected. We keep order data for 7 years in accordance with tax legislation. You can always request deletion of your data via

thirdParties.title: 5. SHARING WITH THIRD PARTIES
thirdParties.intro: We only share your data with:
items: Shipping partners (for delivery of your order)
Mollie (for secure payment processing)
Hosting providers (for data storage)
thirdParties.outro: We never sell your data to third parties and only share it when necessary for fulfilling your order.

security.title: 6. SECURITY
security.content: We take the protection of your data seriously and have implemented appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against loss or unlawful processing. We use SSL encryption for all data transfer and secure servers for storage.

cookies.title: 7. COOKIES
cookies.content: We use functional cookies that are necessary for the proper functioning of the website (such as your shopping cart). We ask for your consent for analytical cookies. You can always refuse cookies through your browser settings.

rights.title: 8. YOUR RIGHTS
items: Request access to your personal data
Have your data corrected or deleted
Object to processing
Transfer your data (data portability)
rights.outro: Contact us via {email} to exercise these rights.

changes.title: 9. CHANGES
changes.content: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. You can always find the most recent version on this page. We will communicate important changes via email.

contact.title: 10. CONTACT
contact.intro: Do you have questions about this privacy policy? Contact us:

general.title: 1. GENERAL
general.content: These terms and conditions apply to all offers and agreements of MOSE (mosewear.com), located in Groningen, Netherlands. By placing an order, you agree to these terms.

pricing.title: 2. OFFERS AND PRICES
items: All prices are in euros and include VAT
Shipping costs are listed separately at checkout
Free shipping from €{threshold} within the Netherlands and Belgium
Prices and stock may change without prior notice
pricing.itemAltijd: Free shipping within the Netherlands and Belgium, no minimum order value

ordering.title: 3. ORDERING
ordering.content: Your order is only final after we have sent an order confirmation by email. We reserve the right to refuse or cancel orders, for example in case of incorrect prices or suspected abuse.

payment.title: 4. PAYMENT
items: Payment takes place through the secure payment page opened at checkout.
Available payment methods are shown at checkout and may vary by country.
We dispatch your order after payment is confirmed.
If payment is interrupted, we check its status first to prevent duplicate payments.

shipping.title: 5. SHIPPING
items: Delivery options and shipping costs are shown at checkout.
Delivery estimates are shown before payment. Mixed orders may arrive in separate parcels.
You will receive a track & trace code upon shipment
Shipping costs: €{cost} (free from €{threshold})
shipping.itemAltijd: Shipping costs: free within the Netherlands and Belgium

returns.title: 6. RETURNS
items: Register your return within {days} days of receipt through your account or by email. Your statutory right of withdrawal remains unaffected.
You may try on and inspect items as you would in a shop. Handling beyond what is necessary to assess an item may result in a deduction for diminished value.
After notifying us of withdrawal, return the items within 14 days. Pack them securely and keep proof of postage.

A MOSE return label for the Netherlands or Belgium costs €{returnCost}, paid when the label is created. We do not deduct that fee again from your refund. Returns for defects or incorrect deliveries are free.

We refund the original payment method. For statutory withdrawal, repayment is due within 14 days of notification; we may wait for the goods or proof of dispatch. Our usual processing time after receipt is 5–7 business days, within that statutory deadline.

warranty.title: 7. WARRANTY
warranty.content: You are entitled to goods that meet reasonable expectations. Your statutory rights are not limited to a fixed warranty period. Report defects to info@mosewear.com so we can arrange an appropriate solution free of charge where required. Normal wear and damage caused by misuse are excluded.

liability.title: 8. LIABILITY
liability.content: These terms do not limit mandatory consumer rights. Contact us if there is a problem so we can investigate and provide an appropriate solution.

disputes.title: 9. DISPUTES
disputes.content: Dutch law applies without depriving you of mandatory consumer protections in your country of residence. Disputes may be brought before the court that has jurisdiction under applicable law.

contact.title: 10. QUESTIONS
contact.content: Do you have questions about these terms? Contact us via {email} or call {phone}.

story.title: GOOD CLOTHES. EVERY DAY.
story.paragraph1: MOSE makes clothes for men who appreciate a substantial hoodie, a good T-shirt and comfortable trousers. Clear shapes, understated colours and considered details. Clothes that are easy to combine and easy to reach for.
story.paragraph2: It starts with the fit and feel. Room where you need it, a substantial fabric and a logo that does not demand attention. From a simple Tee to a boxy hoodie or barrel jeans, each style has its own shape and character.

local.title: NO NONSENSE. PURE CHARACTER.
local.text: A good outfit comes down to how you put it together. A favourite shirt and jeans. A hoodie for heading out. A sweater you can pull on and go. MOSE gives you the foundation; you make it your own.

quality.title: The fabric
quality.text: The feel and drape of a fabric matter. Each product lists its composition and material details.

localMade.title: The fit
localMade.text: From regular to boxy and relaxed. The shape should suit the garment. Use the size chart to find your fit.

fairPricing.title: The details
fairPricing.text: Understated colours, subtle logos and considered finishing. Enough to give each piece its own character.

noHassle.title: Straightforward service
noHassle.text: Need help with a size or an order? Get in touch. You have {days} days to register your return.
noHassle.textAltijd: Need help with a size or an order? Get in touch. You have {days} days to register your return.

sustainable.title: For every day
sustainable.text: Clothes for the days when you want to look good without overthinking it.

stylish.title: Easy to combine
stylish.text: Hoodies, shirts, sweaters and trousers that work together and with the clothes you already wear.

local.title: A character of its own
local.text: Strong shapes and understated details. A rugged look without the noise.

insiderBehindScenes.closing: That is what we look for at MOSE: fit, fabric and character.
insiderBehindScenes.ps: P.S. Launch is in {days} days. You have early access. Use it.
